language.name: English
help.title: 🎶 **DJ Snake commands**
help.cmd.play: `{prefix}play <link or text>`: play a YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Spotify, Deezer or Apple Music link, or the best YouTube match for some text
help.cmd.seek: `{prefix}seek <position>`: jump to a position (seconds or mm:ss)
help.cmd.crossfade: `{prefix}crossfade on|off`: blend each track into the next
help.cmd.stop: `{prefix}stop`: stop, clear the queue and leave the voice channel
help.cmd.language: `{prefix}language [code|reset]`: language of the bot and the clip page (Manage Server)
help.cmd.loop: `{prefix}loop [off|track|queue]`: repeat the track or the queue (empty cycles)
help.cmd.volume: `{prefix}volume [0-150]`: show or set the server's volume
help.cmd.autoplay: `{prefix}autoplay [on|off]`: keep playing related tracks when the queue runs out
help.cmd.playlist: `{prefix}playlist save|add|load|show|delete <name>`, `{prefix}playlist list`: saved playlists of the server
help.cmd.djrole: `{prefix}djrole [role|off]`: the role that may control the music (Manage Server)
help.cmd.weblink: `{prefix}weblink`: get the clip page links by direct message

cmd.djrole_info:
🎧 DJ role: {current}
`{prefix}djrole <role>` limits skip, pause, seek, stop, reset, crossfade, loop, shuffle, volume, autoplay and the clip page's control link to that role and Manage Server; `{prefix}djrole off` opens them to everyone again.

cmd.djrole_everyone: ❌ @everyone can't be the DJ role. Use `{prefix}djrole off` to let everyone control the music.
cmd.djrole_save_failed: ❌ Could not save the DJ role (is DATA_DIR writable?).
